QuestInfo.0: Commander #p2560114:# has given you a lot to think about, and hopefully nothing's gone wrong in the meantime. Maybe you should see what #b#p2560103:##k wanted to tell you.

0.msg: Hurry to #r#m307000230:##k and meet #b#p2560113:##k as soon as you can!
